title: Peruvian Anticuchos Recipe
description: Delicious grilled beef heart skewers marinated in a mix of Peruvian spices and served with a side of roasted tomatoes.

ingredients.name: beef heart
ingredients.notes: make sure to cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, olive oil, garlic, aji amarillo pepper, cumin, and peruvian anticuchos spice blend.
Add the beef heart pieces to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated beef heart pieces onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with roasted tomatoes and enjoy!
